prerequisites: Programming knowledge from basic degree subjects

learning_outcomes.text: Know and be able to use useful tools in Business Intelligence
Be able to design and create a data warehouse.
Correctly use data warehouse exploitation tools
Correctly use tools for selection, analysis, and transformation of a Web information representation system
Know and apply knowledge inference models to aid decision-making

syllabus_topics: Design and exploitation of a data warehouse
Retrieval and exploitation of web information
Information inference models for decision making

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation of group or individual work related to theory
Formative and continuous evaluation of practices
Final evaluation of practices (product, report, and oral presentation if necessary)

assessment_rules: For students with a theory work grade greater than or equal to 7, the final grade is 0.5 * practice grade + 0.5 * average theory work. For students with a theory work grade less than 7, a theory exam is given (15% weight), and the final grade is 0.5 * practice grade + 0.35 * average theory work + 0.15 * theory exam grade. It is necessary to pass the theoretical and practical parts of the subject separately. In non-presential evaluation, the theory exam will be oral.
bibliography: All necessary material (notes, transparencies, complementary material) is available on the "Campus Virtual" corporate platform.
